name: Phoronix: llama.cpp Vulkan, Arc B580 vs RX 9000 vs RTX 50 (b7083, Dec 2025)
notes: Michael Larabel, 2025-12-08, OpenBenchmarking result 2512070-NE-LLAMACPPV90. llama.cpp b7083, Vulkan backend on every card, one shared host, Linux 6.18 + Mesa 26.0-dev (ANV for the Arc B580, RADV for the Radeons), NVIDIA 580.95.05 open kernel driver for the GeForce cards. Phoronix Test Suite, N=3 geometric mean, tokens/second. Article pages are charts; the numbers filed from this source were read off the published result SVGs at phoronix.com/benchmark/result/llamacpp-vulkan-december-2025-gpu-comparison/. Larabel notes he did not have an RTX 5060 Ti 16GB-vs-8GB distinction called out beyond the card name, and did not have an Arc Pro B60 or an RTX PRO Blackwell card. Third-party lab measurement.
